Risk_Description: Unauthorized users may receive access to sensitive systems
Control_Objective: Ensure access is approved before provisioning
Control_Activity: Managers approve access requests and IT provisions permissions based on approved roles
Expected_Evidence: Access request tickets;manager approvals;Entra ID user exports
Design_Test_Procedure: Inspect documented provisioning procedures and approval requirements
Operating_Test_Procedure: Select a sample of new users and compare access grants against approved requests

Risk_Description: Former employees may retain access after termination
Control_Objective: Ensure terminated users lose access within the defined timeframe
Control_Activity: HR notifies IT of departures and IT disables accounts according to the termination procedure
Expected_Evidence: HR termination records;account disable timestamps;termination tickets
Design_Test_Procedure: Inspect termination procedures and required access removal timelines
Operating_Test_Procedure: Compare sampled termination dates against account disable timestamps

Risk_Description: Compromised passwords may allow unauthorized account access
Control_Activity: Entra ID conditional access policies enforce MFA for designated user groups
Expected_Evidence: Conditional access policy exports;authentication logs;MFA coverage reports
Design_Test_Procedure: Inspect MFA policy configuration and documented exceptions
Operating_Test_Procedure: Inspect sampled authentication events and verify MFA enforcement where applicable

Risk_Description: Excessive privileged access may enable unauthorized system changes
Control_Objective: Restrict privileged access to authorized personnel
Control_Activity: Privileged roles are approved and assigned according to least privilege requirements
Expected_Evidence: Privileged role assignments;approval tickets;administrative activity logs
Design_Test_Procedure: Inspect privileged access policies and role assignment requirements
Operating_Test_Procedure: Compare sampled privileged accounts against approved access records

Risk_Description: Inappropriate user permissions may remain undetected
Control_Activity: Application and system owners review access assignments and document remediation decisions
Design_Test_Procedure: Inspect access review procedures and required review frequency
Operating_Test_Procedure: Examine sampled quarterly reviews and verify completion and remediation follow-up
